request.prompt: Stylised hand-painted game VFX with crisp dark outlines, on a pure black background. A sprite sheet for a video game visual effect: 16 sequential animation frames arranged in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: a solar burst. Frame 1: a small golden spark at the centre. Frames 2 to 5: a blinding golden-white sun disc swells with long rays shooting out in every direction. Frames 6 to 9: a ring of golden light expands outward with a rain of gold sparks. Frames 10 to 16: the disc shrinks, the rays and sparks fade and dim until the last frame is nearly black. Bold saturated gold, orange and white.
